写成 \"meta\": { \"on\": [ { \"when\": 触发器: Use "meta": { "on": [ { "when": trigger, "do": [ action ] } ] }. Set "meta.key" to effect:<plugin id>:<name>, using this plugin's own id.
写成 { \"其他插件的 id\": \"版本范围\" }，例如 { \"bas: Write { "other plugin ID": "version range" }, for example { "base-skin": ">=1.0.0" }; you cannot write yourself, and the same plug-in cannot be both required and conflicting, up to 32.
{ \"$setting\": \"名字\" } 里的名字要在清单的 \"set: The names in { "$setting": "name" } should be declared in "settings" of the manifest.
每条消息都是 { \"v\": 1, \"t\": 类型, … }，类型只能是: Each message is { "v": 1, "t": type, … }, the type can only be ready, slot, resize, storage, notice, stats, and each message cannot exceed 8 KB; see schemas/ui.schema.json for the format.
一份 offers/*.json 是 { \"offer\": 1, \"id\: An offer/*.json is { "offer": 1, "id": "window name", "when": { "at": ["battleCheck" or "prep"], "rounds": rounds }, "windowSec": seconds, "slots": 1–6, "options": { "source": "JSON file in the plugin" } }; windowSec defaults to 0 (no window opening, no blocking).
整份规格是一个对象：{ \"dsl\": 1, \"pluginId\": \": The entire specification is an object: { "dsl": 1, "pluginId": "plugin ID", followed by "skill"、"skills"、"talents" or "meta" }.
条件写成 { \"条件名\": 值 }，条件名用 chance、targetHa: The condition is written as { "condition": value }, and the condition names are chance, targetHas, selfHpBelow, enemiesInRange, bondActive, and skillActive; only round, chance, and bondActive can be used for preparation.
目标用 self、target、source、alliesInRange、ene: The target uses self, target, source, alliesInRange, enemiesInRange, enemiesInRadius, lowestHpAlly, allAllies; the "tile" of spawnToken writes "around" or { "r": row, "c": column }.
取值是数字、{ \"bb\": \"键\" }、{ \"talent\": [序: The value is a number, { "bb": "key" }, { "talent": [index, "key"] }, or a combination using mul, add, sub, div, min, max; the list can only be written in these combinations.
\"talents\" 是列表，每一项是 { \"when\": 触发器, \": "talents" is a list, each item is an object like { "when": trigger, "if": condition, "do": [ action ] }.

속세의 음 기본 피해를 50에서 80으로 변경했습니다. 매초 피해는 80: Voice of Mundane base damage changed from 50 to 80. Damage per second is 80 + 1% of the caster's ATK + 0.01% of their ATK per Leithanien stack.
속세의 음 매초 피해를 50 + 시전자 공격력의 1% + 라이타니엔 중첩: Voice of Mundane damage per second changed to 50 + 1% of the caster's ATK + 0.01% ATK per Leithanien stack, using ATK at the time of application.
동일 오퍼레이터가 동일 적에게 속세의 음을 다시 부여하는 대기 시간은 0: Reapplying Voice of Mundane has a 0.1-second cooldown per Operator/target pair. At the 6-Operator threshold, its base 10-second duration gains 1 second per 25 stacks.
비비아나의 특질은 속세의 음을 5회 적용할 때마다 활성화된 라이타니엔/기: Every 5 applications of Voice of Mundane, Viviana's trait grants active Leithanien/Swift stacks: +2/+1 normally or +4/+2 when promoted, up to 10 triggers per battle.
속세의 음 중첩은 체력바 왼쪽의 전용 아이콘과 숫자로 표시하고, 적용된: Voice of Mundane stacks appear as an icon and count to the left of the HP bar, with a purple treble clef on affected enemies. Damage is recorded for the owning Operator without floating damage numbers.
에벤홀츠 2스킬 잔영 등 소환물의 피해에도 소유자의 속세의 음을 적용하고: Damage from summons, including Ebenholz's Skill 2 remnants, also applies the owner's Voice of Mundane and shares the same caster/target cooldown.
피해 유형을 물리(붉은색), 마법(푸른색), 원소(청록색), 속세의 음(: Standardized damage types in records and graphs: Physical (red), Arts (blue), Elemental (teal), Voice of Mundane (purple), True (white), and Unspecified (gray). Refined summary/detail tabs and graph layout.
속세의 음의 별도 피해 증가 효과를 제거하고 매초 피해를 시전자 공격력의: Removed the separate Voice of Mundane damage bonus. Damage per second is now 5% of the caster's ATK + 0.015% per Alliance stack.
Added a 0.2-second cooldown per Operator for Voice of Mundane. Simultaneous area attacks apply it separately to different targets.
Show Voice of Mundane stacks in small text directly above the target's HP bar.
속세의 음 피해 증가량은 기본 +20%·중첩당 +0.25%입니다. 6시너: Voice of Mundane gains +20% damage plus +0.25% per stack. The 6-Operator effect reduces enemy damage and movement speed by 25%; duration is 10 seconds plus 1 second per 30 stacks.
속세의 음은 중첩별 지속시간과 시전자별 피해 통계를 유지하며 같은 시점: Voice of Mundane preserves independent stack durations and per-caster damage statistics, combining simultaneous damage. Hide damage numbers and highlight the name. Removed the stack-count debug label above targets in production.

방 제목을 최대 15자로 수정할 수 있습니다. 기본 제목은 방장 닉네임과: Room titles can be edited up to 15 characters. Default titles include the host name and player count. Public rooms cannot change gameplay mode.
커스텀에 스탯별 증강 누적 방식을 추가하고, 덮어쓰기·삭제할 수 없는 증: Custom settings now offer cumulative augment scaling for individual stats, plus a protected Augment Mode preset that cannot be overwritten or deleted.
증강 모드는 적 증강을 참가자 투표로 결정합니다. 일반 투표에서 과반수를: Augment Mode uses player voting for enemy augments. A strict majority shortens the remaining time to 10 seconds if more than 10 seconds remain.
적 증강에 가중치 투표를 추가했습니다. 투표 수에 비례한 확률로 선택하며: Weighted voting is available for enemy augments. Each option is drawn in proportion to its votes, including the shared reroll option.

돌파는 전투 포기로 누수 처리된 적에도 적용되며, 추가 HP 차감은 라운: Breakthrough also applies to enemies leaked by surrendering, with at most 10 extra HP lost per round. Shared HP is supported; Unite Phase does not charge it again.
Adjusted the room-count font and size on Explore.
영어 맹약 용어와 공식 명칭 표기를 정리하고 보조 맹약 표기를 부가 맹약: Standardized English Alliance terminology and official names, and unified the Korean term for Add-on Alliances.
